nodes.label: Blackfly S BFS-U3-04S2C (serial 22514545)
nodes.rationale: The measured record of the rig camera; when it and a design document disagree, the measurement wins. The trailing C is colour, and the cp310 PySpin wheel is why the acquisition PC is pinned to Python 3.10.

nodes.label: 720 × 540 Sensor Correction (not 1280 × 720)
nodes.rationale: The old '720p60' note was a misreading of '720 × 540'; every derived figure was wrong-high. Corrected: raw rate 11.7 MB/s not ~25, pre-roll ~23 MB not ~55, storage far below the ~37 MB/min estimate.

nodes.label: Auto-Exposure / Auto-Gain Covariance Problem
nodes.rationale: ExposureAuto and GainAuto re-tune continuously as the rat descends, so image appearance covaries with the very thing DLC is trained to locate. Read 14999 µs on one probe and 1002 µs on another; the problem is not that 15 ms is long, it is that the value is not under anyone's control.

nodes.label: Chunk Data Off As Shipped
nodes.rationale: FrameID and Timestamp chunks and ChunkModeActive are all False as shipped. TimestampIncrement reads 1000, so the counter is 1 µs resolution expressed in nanoseconds and needs no scaling — but read the node at open() rather than hardcoding it, since it is a per-model property.

nodes.label: Transport-Layer Stream Buffer Settings
nodes.rationale: These live in the transport-layer stream nodemap, which user sets do not cover, so the app must own them and there is no invariant 7 tension. OldestFirst back-pressures rather than discarding, which is what a recorder wants; NewestOnly silently drops and is right only for a live viewer. 10 buffers is ~0.33 s of slack at 30 fps, 64 gives ~2 s.

nodes.label: Read-Only Nodes = Spinnaker Parameter Lock
nodes.rationale: UserSetLoad/UserSetSave/PixelFormat/Width/Height going RO together means another Spinnaker session has the camera latched, not a firmware fault. DeviceAccessStatus, StreamIsGrabbing and TLParamsLocked are host-side state for the probing process and cannot observe a different process — the original diagnosis leaned on them and was wrong. The reliable test is whether the whole cluster is RO at once.

nodes.label: UserSet1 Has Never Been Configured
nodes.rationale: Default, UserSet0 and UserSet1 are identical factory defaults; nothing in this repo has ever executed UserSetSave. So config.toml's user_set = "UserSet1" loads factory settings and preflight correctly fails every [camera_verify] check that matters.

nodes.label: 60-Second Pipeline Measurement Under Load
nodes.rationale: 3960 frames in 60.0 s at 66.0 fps free-running with zero drops, zero incomplete, zero frame-ID gaps, monotonic hardware timestamps, h264_qsv output at 5.6 MB/min. Sustaining more than double the configured 30 fps is the real evidence for invariants 3 and 10.
